What happened was that I was leaving my local grocery store about half an hour after it opened, a woman turned up the parking lot aisle and by the time I got to my car she was backing up to snag a spot of someone else who just got in their car. I didn't know that at the time and I don't know if she saw me getting into my car. Either way she was in the middle of the aisle and was barely blocking me in.

I waited a few seconds but she was unresponsive to the fact I wanted to leave. I couldn't see anyone leaving at that point t so I decided, "fuck this I need to get home and make breakfast" and started to pull out. I had enough room to back out one way but not the other. Well she saw me and honked. I stopped looked for a few more seconds and still couldn't see who she was waiting for, so started backing up again and squeezed by her and left. Now her face spoke volumes and and just let it go...sorta. Also, I will admit the maneuver was tight, so I admit I probably should have waited, or at the very least got out and told her to move her lazy ass.

Anyway, I had to travel down the next aisle which took another minute or so and turn the corner. As I past the other end of the original aisle I noticed she took my spot and the guy she was waiting on was just leaving. This is when I was dumb.

I proceeded to go back and confront her. She was just exiting her car, saw me and proceeded to curse me out. She wouldn't let me get a word in edgewise and then took a picture of my license plate and threaten to call the cops because I was intimidating her...

At this point I said go ahead, and told her I would wait and let them know she was obstructing the flow of traffic. She kept yelling obscenities and harassing me as I tried to talk some sense into this whacko. For example, telling her to park a few spots down in one of the many open spots. She kept yelling that i was not a gentleman, and i should not reproduce (too late btw). At that point I was out of my car (again stupid) so for shits and giggles I took a picture of her license plate and since she wasn't calling the police I threw the threat right back at her. I even tried asking her what her name was and she refused, and I decided I had enough and left at that point.

So what are the lessons here?

First don't deal with crazy. If someone is going pyscho and you know it just exit the situation. You will not talk sense into them, and you are putting yourself in harm's way. I got really lucky here. If she got lucky I could have been arrested on the spot if she got the right officer just for "harassing" her.

Second, two wrongs don't make a right. In a way I did wrong her, but by being a total bitch this woman made me want to rip her throat out. I think this can be applied to SJWs too. Some of their arguments have merit, but they are going about it the wrong way, and therefore I don't care.

Finally, try not to be an ass. I had the opportunity to avoid this whole situation and so did she. Unfortunately for me I was no longer in control once she went off, and I should have applied lesson number one.

Either way sorry for the wall of text. I feel like the lessons here might help others realize how they need to deal with overly zealous individuals who are incapable of seeing things from other points of view.
